metadata.label: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 5 curriculum

ontario-science-g5-all-strands.documentTitle: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 5 - Overall Expectations

standards.summaryText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
standards.officialOutcomeText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

standards.summaryText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields
standards.officialOutcomeText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

standards.summaryText: analyse impacts of various social and environmental factors, human activities, and technologies on human health
standards.officialOutcomeText: analyse impacts of various social and environmental factors, human activities, and technologies on human health
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the structure and function of human body systems and interactions within and between systems
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the structure and function of human body systems and interactions within and between systems

standards.summaryText: assess the impacts on society and the environment of various processes and materials used in the manufacture of common products, and ways to mitigate negative impacts
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the impacts on society and the environment of various processes and materials used in the manufacture of common products, and ways to mitigate negative impacts
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the properties of matter, changes of state, and physical and chemical change
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the properties of matter, changes of state, and physical and chemical change

standards.summaryText: analyse social and environmental impacts of forces acting on structures, and assess ways to mitigate these impacts
standards.officialOutcomeText: analyse social and environmental impacts of forces acting on structures, and assess ways to mitigate these impacts
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of forces that act on structures, and how various structures withstand them
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of forces that act on structures, and how various structures withstand them

standards.summaryText: assess effects of energy and resource use on society and the environment, and suggest options for conserving energy and resources
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess effects of energy and resource use on society and the environment, and suggest options for conserving energy and resources
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the conservation of energy, and the forms, sources, and uses of energy and resources
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the conservation of energy, and the forms, sources, and uses of energy and resources
